newsitem.title: GAMBIA: Gambia army ruler wins poll - official results.
newsitem.headline: Gambia army ruler wins poll - official results.

text.p: Gambia's military leader Yahya Jammeh coasted to an emphatic victory on Friday in presidential elections to return the country to democracy after two years of army rule, official results showed.

With 45 of 47 constituencies, or 81 percent of the vote, counted, Jammeh scored 199,650 votes or 55 percent. His strongest challenger, lawyer Ousaino Darboe received 131,035 votes or 36 percent of votes, according to official returns issued by the electoral commission, PIEC.
The remaining constituencies have a total of 70,000 votes only, guaranteeing Jammeh victory.
Two marginal civilian candidates who scored 36 percent and three perecent each never had a real chance in the elections held on Thursday.
Electoral commission chairman Gabriel Roberts was expected to make a formal declaration of results later.
